investigation: At the matched 2560 × 1440 view each Sky arm exceeded the 8.33 ms refresh interval. Trace and compose dominate, with constant ray and texture counts. The decks terminate each opaque ray earlier and fair rays visit many empty samples. The counter includes empty visits and excludes nested Sun samples. This accounts for much more measured trace time per visit in the decks. In this sample no named cloud pass increased at least 25% relative to fair. An earlier sample at 113eae10b2 registered that tripwire in hemisphere light and resolve. The hemisphere-light dispatch has the same dimensions and consumes the same clear-air inputs for every arm. It increased by 0.09 ms in that sample. Resolve also has fixed dispatch dimensions, while more opaque fronts enter its reprojection branch. Shared load varied and the increase did not reproduce in the current sample. Keep the pass times, input coverage and sample counts for whole-frame tuning.
estimates: CLOUDS DESIGN cost account: weather <0.1 ms, Sun 0.1–0.2 ms, ground <0.05 ms; profiles and resource bytes recorded separately.
